proof_checks.zero_baseline_subtracted_change: The model potential differences across B's edge are exactly the same before and after C gains it. The event-induced change in that contrast, measured at B, is zero.
proof_checks.dipole_distinguished: A positive source perturbation (+1/2 at 9, -1/2 at 0) gives a difference of 1/2 on this edge. The model potential differences across B's edge are 2 and 5/2 both immediately before and immediately after C gains it.
proof_checks.quadratic_edge_term: The normalized Dirichlet term F9^2/2 gives 2 and 25/8 for base and shifted inputs. Zero and signed controls give 0 and 1/2.
proof_checks.ungrounded_schur_argument: Lplus = [[L + ee^T, -e], [-e^T, 1]]. Eliminating the leaf from the field equations gives L as the old-site operator exactly: reduced = full[:-1,:-1] - full[:-1,-1:] * full[-1:,:-1] / full[-1,-1] == full_laplacian(p, coarse).
proof_checks.balanced_load_push: A balanced arbitrary load is handled linearly: rhs = sp.Matrix(load[:-1]) - full[:-1,-1:] * load[-1] / full[-1,-1] == sp.Matrix(folded).
proof_checks.susceptibilities_and_resistances: All effective resistances between old sites and the entire response matrix to probes on them are identical: resistance(fine_green, i, j) == resistance(coarse_green, i, j). 66 unordered old-port pair comparisons passed (24, 24, 18).
proof_checks.altered_loads_vs_coupling: Any extension between finite connected prefix-closed charts of one fixed unit tree consists of such pendant additions. Repeated elimination proves the fixed-port result on their common retained chart. A change in static coupling must supply some operation outside this restriction.
proof_checks.w1_w2_rational_increment_space: The exact unrestricted increment ranks at C's gain were 3, 4 and 2. The free edges were {4,6,7}, {3,4,5,6} and {4,6}.

proof_checks.end_of_protection_and_continuations: At the next edit, +A1, A is the only chart holding 9. Two compatible histories with the same original all-2 source can have A(9)=2 or 5/2 at state 11.
